programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Mystery of the Headphones
programme.desc: A killer evades justice for the murder of Diana Hanson for 38 years until genetic genealogy can identify him.

programme.title: Stabbing in Sacramento
programme.desc: 40 years after the sexual assault and murder of 20-year-old Robin Brooks in Sacramento, California, determined cold case detectives collaborate with scientists using revolutionary forensic techniques to identify her killer and put him behind bars.

programme.title: The Price of Love
programme.desc: In Hewitt, TX aspiring minister Matt Baker, 34, returns home to discover his wife Keri, 31, has overdosed on pills and alcohol. Matt claims he tied her up for sex then left to rent a movie.

programme.title: Saints and Sinners
programme.desc: A wicked church minister, and a teacher falls for a student.

programme.title: Steamy Lessons
programme.desc: A pregnant wife killed execution style and an EMT intent on taking a life.

programme.title: Body Park
programme.desc: Two mysterious New Jersey murder cases where the victims are found in parks.

programme.title: Dead Pool
programme.desc: Two Pennsylvania murder cases involving cheating spouses with evil minds.

programme.title: Intoxicated Motorcyclist
programme.desc: Daytona Beach officers search for a wanted man; Indian River Co. officers look for an intoxicated motorcyclist.

programme.title: Flight Risk
programme.desc: With a D.U.I., this fugitive is a habitual traffic offender and has numerous warrants out for "failure to appear". With charges of intent to sell methamphetamine, a fugitive poses as a high flight risk.

programme.title: The Bad-Tempered Boyfriend
programme.desc: Erin Chorney, 18, vanished. Police suspected her abusive boyfriend, Michael Bridges. Undercover officers got Bridges to confess; he's arrested.

programme.title: Nicole White
programme.desc: When young mother Nicole White met Jonathan Harris online, he seemed like her ideal rugged man. CCTV from their second date at Jeepers Bar showed a great start, but Harris's mood changed. They drove off in Nicole's car, but she never made it home.

programme.title: The Campus Killer
programme.desc: Katherine Foster found shot at UA. Campus guard suspected, then cleared. Cold case reopens 20 years later after confession by a friend during AA.

programme.title: Donna Perry
programme.desc: In Spokane three prostitutes were violently killed. Evidence suggested they'd been approached by a man wanting sex who had then used great strength to subdue and kill them. They had the suspects DNA, but detectives had no idea who the killer was.

programme.title: Murder of Yvonne Menke
programme.desc: A single mother was executed outside her front door, and detectives suspected a deadly love triangle. Four decades later, new witnesses helped prosecutors convict the other woman involved in the affair for the murder.

programme.title: Under the Influence
programme.desc: A mom is cuffed outside her child's school after police allegedly find her driving with narcotics.

programme.title: Driving Crazy
programme.desc: Officers pull over a woman after multiple callers reported her erratic driving.

programme.title: Amy Fisher
programme.desc: In 1992, 17-year-old Amy Fisher became known as the Long Island Lolita when she shot her lover, Joey Buttafuocco's, wife in the head. The victim, Mary Jo, gives her first-hand account of the shooting and what she thinks of Amy and Joey today.

programme.title: Surviving Prison
programme.desc: How do inmates survive within the strict confines of Singapore's only women's prison?

programme.title: Rachel and Diane Staudte
programme.desc: This episode examines the notorious "Antifreeze Murders" that took place in 2012. Diane and Rachel Staudte murdered two members of their family and attempted to kill a third before police got involved.

programme.title: Masons of Horror
programme.desc: Branded as the "Builders of Horror," the disappearance of Jocelyne and Jean-Claude Saint Aubert sent shockwaves through their tranquil neighborhood.

programme.title: Kayleigh Haywood
programme.desc: Kayleigh Haywood was 15 years old when 27-year-old Luke Harlow contacted her out of the blue online. He bombarded her with messages. From this intense grooming, Luke Harlow persuaded Kayleigh to lie to her parents in order to meet him.

programme.title: Summer of Fear
programme.desc: Random shootings, rapes, and robberies leave almost all of the residents of Phoenix, Arizona scared. On top of that, authorities are seemingly powerless against serial killers that are waging a war of terror on the streets of this Arizona city.

programme.title: Finding Dr Crippen
programme.desc: Having killed his wife and buried her in the basement, Dr Crippen believed he had escaped on a ship to Canada.

programme.title: The Brides In The Bath Killer
programme.desc: George Smith had many aliases. He needed them for his many wives who he would soon murder in order to claim the inheritance.

programme.title: Deady Vengeance
programme.desc: On September 2nd 2015, the body of 2 years-old Méline is found in her home. Her father confesses to the murder.

programme.title: Rachel and Diane Staudte
programme.desc: This episode examines the notorious "Antifreeze Murders" that took place in 2012. Diane and Rachel Staudte murdered two members of their family and attempted to kill a third before police got involved.

programme.title: Entitled Suspects
programme.desc: "Untouchable" suspects square off with police.

programme.title: Maximum Mayhem
programme.desc: Criminal behavior caught on camera.

programme.title: Body Overboard
programme.desc: A woman's husband reports her falling overboard into Lake Erie, but police don't buy his story.

programme.title: A Killing in Kansas
programme.desc: In 1989, 20-year-old Krista Martin is murdered by an intruder in Wichita, Kansas. After a 40-year investigation, will investigative genetic genealogy provide answers for her family?

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: A married soldier begins a dangerous affair and a Canadian wife ends a life.

programme.title: Blast from the Past
programme.desc: A newlywed wife with a violent ex-husband in Washington State, and in Lisburn, Northern Ireland, a Fire Chief want to extinguish a love rival.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: A Kentucky airline pilot murdered for money and in the UK a former golf pro attacked by his wife's young lover.

programme.title: Date with Death
programme.desc: In Washington State a husband goes missing and in the UK could there be killer swingers?

programme.title: Love Me 'til You Die
programme.desc: A killer leaves a calling card in Las Vegas and there's something shocking in a car's trunk in Melbourne, Australia.

programme.title: Devious Minds
programme.desc: A devious plan to kill a prominent politician in Reno, NV, and in Coventry, England an office romance gets out of hand and leads to a woman's disappearance.

programme.title: Beach Bash
programme.desc: Officers investigate shots fired, respond to a domestic violence call, find a driver passed out behind the wheel and find a large party on the beach.

programme.title: Arrested In The Shower
programme.desc: Bounty Hunters arrest a young fugitive on a bond surrender, yet he does not understand the charges and why he's going back into custody. A fugitive is a notorious drug offender who has been charged with a Failure to Appear warrant.

programme.title: Double Cross Killer
programme.desc: Newlyweds Katie and JD have ever-escalating tension with JD's ex-wife Robin. When Robin is found shot to death, in an apparent robbery gone wrong, police arrest the killer. Or...do they? There is a demon in disguise and only a last-minute discovery will lead detectives to the truth.

programme.title: House of Lies
programme.desc: Keith Gentry is shot in his sleep in the middle of the night, and left to be found by his wife, Darlene. The Texas Rangers are then brought in to investigate the murder, wading through discrepancies and lies as they narrow in on their suspect.

programme.title: Murdered in Bed
programme.desc: An elderly couple are living an idyllic life in a cosy home until a robbery changes everything and one of them is killed.

programme.title: Takedown with Chris Hansen
programme.desc: Over the past two decades, Chris Hansen's investigations have led to hundreds of would-be sex criminals being stopped in their tracks. Amazingly, after 500 arrests and hundreds of millions of video views, men continue to try to meet children online. So, his mission continues.

programme.title: Murder of Bonnie Haim
programme.desc: Bonnie Haim vanished after her husband claimed she left him and their young son. Twenty-six years later, Bonnie's now-adult son Aaron unknowingly uncovered her buried remains beneath an outdoor shower, leading to his father's arrest.

programme.title: Kicked Out
programme.desc: Bar owner asks police to kick a prominent Florida family out of their bar.

programme.title: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: A navy sailor stationed in Key West gets arrested after he allegedly dropped his drawers at several bars.

programme.title: The Bathtub Killer
programme.desc: A woman allegedly drowns in the bathtub, but her husband's story doesn't add up; when his second wife also drowns two years on, police's fears are confirmed.

programme.title: In Losing It
programme.desc: In Singapore's only women's prison, about 800 inmates eat, sleep and live together in close confines.

programme.title: Cheyanne Jessie
programme.desc: Vivica examines the case of double-murderer Cheyanne Jessie. On August 1, 2015, police received a call from Cheyanne Jessie in which she claimed her father Mark Weekly and daughter Meredith were missing.

programme.title: The Hunt For the Essonne Killer
programme.desc: Named the "Essonne Serial Killer," the case of Yoni Palmier unfolded swiftly under the vigilant gaze of Versailles police.

programme.title: Kayleigh Haywood
programme.desc: Kayleigh Haywood was 15 years old when 27-year-old Luke Harlow contacted her out of the blue online. He bombarded her with messages. From this intense grooming, Luke Harlow persuaded Kayleigh to lie to her parents in order to meet him.

programme.title: Terror In The Roaring Twenties
programme.desc: Edith Thompson and Frederick Bywaters were convicted for murdering her husband in a case that shocked society and fascinated Alfred Hitchcock.

programme.title: The Blackout Ripper
programme.desc: London was rocked by the Blitz from the planes flying above during the WWII and a serial killer was loose on the streets below.

programme.title: In the Marabout's Shadow
programme.desc: On November 20th 2013, a fishermen discovers the corpse of a baby on the beach of Berck.

programme.title: Cheyanne Jessie
programme.desc: Vivica examines the case of double-murderer Cheyanne Jessie. On August 1, 2015, police received a call from Cheyanne Jessie in which she claimed her father Mark Weekly and daughter Meredith were missing.

programme.title: Drunkest Arrests
programme.desc: Inebriated suspects learn liquor and the law don't mix.

programme.title: High Speed Chases 3
programme.desc: A drunken biker going 120 mph takes a spill; a bus hijacker triggers terror on a freeway; an armed criminal sets his sights on a law enforcement officer.

programme.title: Body in the Swamp
programme.desc: A murdered woman is found 230 miles from home, dumped from a bridge into a swamp; is the killer someone she met online or is it her own husband?

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit crimes.

programme.title: The Lost Princess

The plot thickens when Blake decides to retire, prompting the shows-ratings hungry producer, Cortez (Claudio Cassinelli) to frame Blake for a crime he didnt commit. And in the future the only way to prove your innocence is by proving you can stay alive in the Battle of the Damned. Fulci bars no holds with his signature extreme style, including slow motion throat slashings, close-up body crushings and the most brutal battle sequences this side of Braveheart! Preceding the RUNNING MAN by three years and proving once again that he is The Godfather of Gore, director Lucio Fulci you his epic vision of the future entertainment in a futuristic society. THE NEW GLADIATORSIts brough to you liveand to the death!

programme.desc: Skwisgaar is to host the Skwisgaar Skwigelf Advanced Hand Finger Wizard Master Class Pay Per View Event, to promote the sales of a new guitar line, which includes the Skwisarmyatar, and the Antfarmatar.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has an end of the quarter employee evaluation to find out who's been embezzling from the company. The patronizing evaluation heads off with a pep talk and a corporate video that will have audiences and Dethfans alike vying for a spot on the Dethklok payroll.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Plagued by his stupidity, Nathan Explosion embarks on the dicey journey of earning his GED.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Depressed, Dethklok is whisked away to the Mississippi Delta to "discover" the Blues.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface searches for a religion after a near-death experience leaves him longing for greater meaning. He samples everything from Christianity to Satanism before finding his true church.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to compensate for his adorable charm by over-brutalizing his intentions and actions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The Tribunal commissions Dr. Rockzo, The Rock N Roll Clown, to gather information on Dethklok. Dr. Rockzo and Toki's sudden friendship has the rest of Dethklok uneasy.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is asked to host the American Pornography Awards, but Nathan's controlling girlfriend puts a damper on the situation for the whole band.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Dethklok is given a Carte Blanche development deal, the future of silver screen entertainment rests in their hands.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In this first season finale, the Metalocalypse creeps closer to fulfillment when Dethklok executes their most brutal performance to date, and the Tribunal finally makes their move.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Since Dethklok's withdrawal from the public following the purported Dethwater Live "fan attack", the world economy teeters on the brink of disaster. Dethklok is finally lured back into the outside world with their protective "pelvic-thrust mace belts" to be a part of the world's largest public execution of criminals in recorded history.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki Wartooth is fed up playing in the shadow of Skwisgaar's lead guitar. Under the tutelage of a crusty old guitar master, Toki learns that the heart, too, has strings.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The wounded, the scared, and the disfigured unite. Meanwhile, an oblivious Dethklok spends their studio time recording onto the purest of all analog formats: water.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Fearing for their safety after a public gun mishap/bloodbath, the CFO hires look-a-likes of Dethklok to make public appearances while the band prepares for a Duncan Hills Coffee promotional event.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When promoting a new clothing line, Dethklok experiences the brutality of negative body image, dieting, and bulimia.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dr. Rockzo, the Rock n Roll Clown, gets help from Dethklok to overcome his cocaine addition and come c-c-c-clean!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Metal meets mid-west etiquette when Pickles' brother, Seth, invites Dethklok to his Wisconsin wedding.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles' popularity soars when he gets a personal P.R. agent, prompting the rest of Dethklok to form a rival P.R. firm. Meanwhile, Pickles' P.R. woman has dark, otherworldy, and religious motives behind her Evil Press Releases.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok travels to the Amazon where they learn about native brutality from the Yannemango Indians.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Nathan Explosion serves an emergency term as temporary governor for the state of Florida, sending Florida into a state of further emergency.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: William Murderface creates the "Nascar-type Theatrical Hybrid Event" and takes all creative and logistical control upon himself. Nathan and Pickles try to be supportive of their overwhelmed pal, while Skwisgaar and Toki attempt to get their driver licenses.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Nathan learns that his ex-girlfriend, Rebecca Nightrod, has already found new love while still in a coma, he decides to return to the dating scene. Unfortunately, the rest of the band makes it difficult for Nathan to make a true love connection.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band is fed up with Offdenson knowing more than they do. They want their fifth of everything and decide to hire an efficiency expert to tighten up matters at Mordhaus and maximize their weekly allowance.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Toki gets news that his dad is dying, he's forced to travel back to his home town in Norway. The rest of the band decides to make a vacation out of it, citing "album inspiration" as their excuse to further put off working on their delayed album.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The world economy is crumbling and waiting for the next Dethklok album to stimulate it back into order. It's up to Dethklok to get the album just right and finished on time.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After the attack on Mordhaus, Dethklok is left without a manager and plagued by greedy record execs and forced to face the brutality of the slumping economy while dabbling in interior design. Will they spend everything and sign a deal that will render them powerless? Or worse, will they allow Murderface to turn the living room into an Arizona-styled sandscape?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok joins their own Dethklok tribute band as a last ditch effort to connect with their rock and roll roots.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After a near-death experience, Dethklok realizes they would rather be sick and not know then face the brutality of going to a doctor. After home remedies including drinking bleach, Dethklok learns that their ultimate fear will be realized, one of them has a terminal illness. Meanwhile Nathan tries to brave the brutality of going to the dentist and Murderface faces the possibility of being gay after accidentally ejaculating on a doctors face. Part of Season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok must experience the ultimate brutality of the Holiday season; spending time with their MOTHERS. Meanwhile Murderface ringleads the ultimate Christmas special that ends up being backed by the Christian church. And a particular ROCK AND ROLL clown makes a holiday appearance. Part of season 3.

programme.title: Love and Hate in Alaska
programme.desc: With nearly one-third of Alaska's communities lacking a police force, the state's crime rate is on a meteoric rise. To build up its law enforcement, Alaska is trying something new: bring up cops from the Lower 48. These officers receive special training for the harsh new world and a bonus up to $40,000 ? but if they quit, they must pay it all back.

programme.title: Eyes of a Killer
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes more than just a fight for survival; it's a terrifying examination of the fragility of peace and the price of freedom in a convoluted world.

programme.desc: An Irish groom's brother plans a hiking trip bachelor party with a no-women rule. When the groom's fiancée's brother shows up with his girlfriend, tensions arise. The weekend camping trip becomes a test of friendships, masculinity, and relationships in the wilderness.

programme.title: Mr. 3000
programme.desc: Aging baseball legend Stan Ross discovers that three of his 3,000 career hits were incorrectly counted. Nine years after retiring, the arrogant player returns to baseball at age 47 to reclaim his record and legacy while learning humility and what truly matters.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Film noir-obsessed video store clerk Neil meets and falls for Violet, a free-spirited woman who pulls him into her world of spontaneous adventures. She stages elaborate film-like scenarios to shake up his routine life, but her extreme methods test whether their romance can survive reality.

programme.title: Two Can Play That Game
programme.desc: Corporate attorney and relationship expert Shante Smith uses her rules for romance to keep her boyfriend in line. When he threatens to stray, she employs her ten-day plan to regain control, but his best friend counters with his own dating strategies in this battle of sexes.

programme.title: My Boss's Daughter
programme.desc: Tom accepts his boss's request to house-sit, hoping to get close to his boss's daughter whom he has a crush on. The evening spirals into disaster as parties, drugs, escaped animals, and unexpected guests turn his romantic opportunity into total chaos.

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: To escape neighborhood bully Deebo, Craig moves to the suburbs to live with his uncle and cousin Day-Day. What should be a peaceful change becomes complicated when they encounter new troubles including thieves, romantic interests, and neighborhood conflicts in Rancho Cucamonga.

programme.title: 500 Days of Summer
programme.desc: Hopeless romantic Tom Hansen works at a greeting card company and falls for Summer, a woman who doesn't believe in true love. The nonlinear narrative follows 500 days of their relationship as Tom reflects on where things went wrong after she unexpectedly dumps him.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Best friends Sidney and Dre share a lifelong love of hip-hop music. As they navigate their careers in the music industry—she as a magazine editor, he as a record executive—they must confront whether their deep connection is just friendship or something more romantic.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: Playboy bunny Shelley is kicked out of the mansion and becomes house mother for a struggling sorority of socially awkward girls. She teaches them about confidence and style while they help her discover there's more to life than appearance, transforming each other in the process.

programme.title: Fruitvale Station
programme.desc: Based on the true story of Oscar Grant's last day, January 1, 2009. The 22-year-old Bay Area resident celebrates New Year's Eve with family and friends before a confrontation with police at Fruitvale BART station leads to his tragic death, sparking national outrage.

programme.title: Friday After Next
programme.desc: Craig and Day-Day work as security guards at a local shopping mall on Christmas Eve. When a crooked Santa Claus robs their apartment, they must navigate holiday chaos, pursue the thief, and try to recover their stolen presents and rent money before it's too late.

programme.title: Take This Waltz
programme.desc: Margot, a happily married woman, develops an intense attraction to her charming neighbor Daniel. She struggles between comfortable marriage and passionate desire, exploring themes of commitment, longing, and whether giving in to temptation will bring happiness or destroy everything.

programme.title: To Cut
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring story of Stuart Linder, a prominent American plasticsurgeon. Once deterred by his teachers from pursuing medical practices, now one of the most sough after professionals in practice.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Unable to come to terms with the death of his brother by the hands of a police officer, Quincy is pushed to face his emotions and navigate his new reality. In doing so, he is presented with an opportunity to seek justice in an unconventional way.

programme.title: Xavier
programme.desc: A biographical documentary short that tells the story of a chance meeting of social media peronality Blake Linder and cancer warrior Xavier Mejias. This visual challenges audiences to reach for higher levels of compassion, selflessness, mentorship and gratefulness while begging the question "are you truly connecting with people on social media".

programme.title: All My Friends Are Robots
programme.desc: After one brother clicks a strange hyperlink, two siblings must battle their best friend—now transformed into a relentless humanoid—before the glitch consumes them all.

programme.title: Ashes To Ashes
programme.desc: When Xavier unexpectedly receives the ashes of his dead father in the mail, he is forced to confront a lifetime of daddy issues.

programme.title: Below Watson's
programme.desc: Beneath the charm of Watson’s Soda Fountain and Café on East Chapman Avenue in Orange, California, lies a mystery sealed in brick and shadow. Once a bustling drug store and diner during the Prohibition era, the café is said to sit above a hidden network of tunnels that have long been blocked from public view. Were these tunnels a lifeline, a smuggling route—or something far more dangerous? This documentary highlights the community that whispers about the layers of history, chasing the echoes of footsteps that may never have wanted to be found.

programme.title: Candles
programme.desc: In this short psychological thriller, a seemingly grieveing and sinister teen boy. Is his therapist an emotional anchor? Or is she someone quite sinister herself?

programme.title: Chick Bait
programme.desc: In this lighthearted comedy, a lonely, overweight man just wants to enjoy a quiet afternoon and his baskin robbins Ice cream. But his simple pleasure takes a wild turn when a mischievous dachshund waddles up, steals his sweet trea. the man tries to shoo the dog away, but fate has other plans. A charming young woman notices the adorable thief and mistakes the man for its doting owner. Suddenly thrust into an unexpected role, he finds himself sharing laughs and lunch with her, daydreaming that maybe, just maybe, this accident could lead to love. But just as the sparks begin to flicker, disaster strikes. The real owner appears, frantic and furious at finding the “lost” dog in the man’s company. A story of ice cream, mistaken identity, and a very determined little dog.

programme.title: Dream To Sell
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring rags to riches story of Simon Sarradine, a prominent American with lebanese ancestry. Once a struggling boy, now the king of a motor-vehicle empire, who continues to dream bigger.

programme.title: Father Figure
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps his two children, consumed by resentment toward his ex-wife, Diana, and convinced that only he can provide them a safe home. But as his desperation grows, Richard's obsessive need for control begins to expose the monstrous reflection of his own flaws. Meanwhile, their fractured family becomes the target of the Father Figure-a sinister entity that preys on children from broken, unstable homes. When the demon abducts the children, Richard is forced to face the consequences of his destructive choices and the darker truths about himself. Now, he must confront the ultimate evil to save his children, before his mistakes doom him forever.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 002: Valentine’s Day Love, Kendrick Lamar’s Super Bowl Performance, & NBA All-Star Weekend Highlights
programme.desc: In this exciting first episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, hosts Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive into all the hottest topics of the season! From the magic of Valentine’s Day love to Kendrick Lamar’s unforgettable Super Bowl halftime performance, this episode covers it all. Plus, get the inside scoop on the NBA All-Star Weekend, the biggest highlights, and what made it so memorable. Join us for a fun and lively conversation about music, sports, and everything in between!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 003: Nike Scandal, Lakers x One Piece Collab, and LA’s Strict Nightlife Rules & Discrimination
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith tackle some of the hottest topics in pop culture and beyond. First up: The mystery behind stolen Nikes—did Nike orchestrate the theft themselves? Then, they dive into the collaboration between the Lakers and One Piece, along with opening exclusive One Piece trading cards! The conversation heats up as they discuss the SAG Awards and the controversial nightlife rules and discrimination issues in big cities like LA. Tune in for an insightful, no-holds-barred discussion on current events and pop culture!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 004: Oscar Buzz, Pokémon Prismatic ETB Box Break, and the Mavericks' Downfall with Kyrie Irving
programme.desc: In this exciting episode of Mic'd: The Podcast Mic & Daniel dive into the latest buzz from the Oscars and what’s making headlines in Hollywood. But that’s not all—things get even more interesting when they break open a Pokémon Prismatic ETB box and explore the world of collectibles. The episode wraps up with a deep dive into the Mavericks’ recent struggles, including Kyrie Irving’s unexpected injury and what this means for the team’s future.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 005: Running the LA Marathon for Charity, Crypto Talk, NFL Trades & Japanese One Piece Cards
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon shares his personal journey as he prepares to run the LA Marathon this Sunday for charity. He talks about the motivation and drive required to commit to such a challenge and explains how anyone can push themselves to achieve big goals, no matter the obstacles. The conversation then shifts to the world of cryptocurrency, as Michelangelo and Daniel Smith break down the latest trends and discuss NFL trades. To cap off the episode, they open some rare Japanese One Piece trading cards.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 006: Adan Castillo on Training the Paul Brothers, Motivation & Pulling a Rare Pokémon Card
programme.desc: This week on Mic’d Up: The Podcast, we welcome a special guest—celebrity boxing coach Adan Castillo, the man behind Logan Paul’s training for The Mayweather Fight and Jake Paul’s transition into pro boxing. Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive deep into the world of elite training, discussing the mindset, motivation, and sacrifices it takes to succeed at the highest level. Beyond the ring, the conversation expands to the importance of inner circles, overcoming struggles, and the drive to chase your goals—whether you’re a celebrity or an everyday person striving for greatness. To top it off, the guys open Pokémon cards and pull the rarest card yet!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 007: Morning Routines That Trend, CONCACAF Nations League Soccer, & Jordan 4 Bricks Review
programme.desc: This week's episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast as Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith unpack the latest trends in morning routines that are sweeping the nation. Discover tips and tricks that might revolutionize your own start to the day. Switching gears, the hosts recap the excitement from the recent CONCACAF Nations League soccer games, discussing standout moments and key plays. Plus, don't miss their exclusive review of the sneaker of the year, the Jordan 4 "Bricks" by Nigel Sylvester.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 008: Avatar's Return, Nokia's Viral Video, Coachella Hype, NBA's Marketing Moves, NFL Rule Changes
programme.desc: Episode 008 of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith delve into the buzz surrounding the upcoming Avatar movie, discussing its potential impact and fan expectations. They analyze Nokia's latest music video that's taking the internet by storm and share their excitement for the approaching Coachella festival, highlighting anticipated performances and trends. The conversation shifts to the NBA, where they examine recent player suspensions and debate whether marketing strategies are influencing league decisions more than ever. They also unpack the NFL's new rule changes for 2025, exploring how adjustments to overtime and kickoff rules could affect game dynamics and betting landscapes . To top it all off, the hosts open a pack of Dragon Ball Z trading cards, aiming for those elusive God Rare cards, and discuss the thrill of collecting and the value of rare finds .

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 009: Coachella Special With The Girls! Festival Drama, Prismatic Evolutions & Dire Wolves Return?
programme.desc: Get festival-ready with this special Coachella episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast! Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith are joined by three special guests who reveal all the drama, stress, and secrets behind getting Coachella-ready. The excitement continues as they open a Pokémon Prismatic Evolutions box, letting the girls test their luck and pull some heat. Michelangelo also shares highlights from an unforgettable weekend with El Cristiano Tequila. Plus, they dive into the astonishing news of scientists bringing back an extinct species—the Dire Wolf. Don't miss this episode packed with festival tips, rare Pokémon cards, wild stories, and mind-blowing science news!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 010: Coachella Recap, WNBA Draft Highlights, Tariffs Shaking Fashion, True Religion Denim
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith recap Michelangelo’s unforgettable Coachella experience—covering standout performances, behind-the-scenes moments, and festival vibes. They dive into the highlights from the recent WNBA Draft and discuss the future of women's basketball. With tariffs impacting fashion and consumer products, the hosts explore what this means for your favorite brands and trends. Michelangelo showcases his fresh pair of True Religion jeans and shares his personal take on fashion’s latest moves. Plus, could dinosaurs really be making a comeback?
